sites.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/480/Little-Tallapoosa-Park ('32 tent/pop-up campsites with 120 watt electrical hook-ups', '23 RV campsites with water, sewer and 30/50 amp electrical hook-ups', '10 equestrian campsites with water and 120 watt, 30 & 50 amp electrical hook-ups'), read 2026-10-29

facilities.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/480/Little-Tallapoosa-Park ('Comfort Station with restrooms, showers, washer and dryer'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: RV water and electric $40 a night, full hookup $50; tents and pop-ups $25. One price for everyone (no county-resident rate posted). $5 daily parking per vehicle, or a $50 annual pass good at all Carroll County parks. Cancellations 14+ days out refunded less $10.

fees.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/480/Little-Tallapoosa-Park ('Park Pass, Reservation & Camping Rate Schedule: Tent, Pop-ups - $25 per night; Full Hookup RV - $50 per night; Water and Electric Only RV - $40 per night; Daily Parking Fee - $5 per vehicle; Annual Pass $50'), read 2026-10-29

values.note: RV and equestrian sites: 14 nights, then away at least 14 days ('There are NO exceptions'). No long-term rates. The county page does not say how to reserve and links no booking engine.

booking.source: https://www.carrollcountyga.gov/480/Little-Tallapoosa-Park ('Cancellations must be made at least 14 days prior to the date of arrival'; 'Do you have long term rates? No, all rates are per night. How long can you stay? RVs and equestrian sites have a 14-night max, then must be gone for no less than 14 days.'), read 2026-10-29

note: Carroll County park (330 acres, 1930 Hwy 113 N, Carrollton): 9+ miles of natural trails, paved trails, a 2-acre fishing pond, splash park (Memorial Day-Labor Day), horse camp. The Little Tallapoosa River runs through the park. --Claude
summary: County page: confirmed 23 RV sites with 30/50 A water/sewer, $40 (W/E) - $50 (full hookup) a night, 14-night max; added showers + laundry, the $5/vehicle daily parking fee, cancellation terms; site count now the 23 RV sites (tent/pop-up and equestrian sites in sites.note).
